label.zh: 元素的电负性变化趋势

cues.title: 把元素排进周期
cues.caption: 原子序数决定顺序；同一列保留相似的价层结构。
cues.captionEn: Atomic number fixes the order; columns align related valence structures.
cues.zh: 先跟着第一列向下看。锂、钠、钾等元素分属不同周期，但最外层都有一个电子。周期表不是任意摆放的名字清单，它同时把原子序数的连续变化和性质的重复联系起来。氢虽也放在这一列，却不能简单当成普通碱金属。
cues.en: Follow the first column downward. Lithium, sodium and potassium occupy different periods, but each has one outer electron. The table connects increasing atomic number with recurring properties. Hydrogen also occupies this column, but it should not simply be treated as an ordinary alkali metal.

cues.title: 同一元素，两种布局
cues.caption: 抽出的14格重新插入，元素身份与先后顺序保持不变。
cues.captionEn: The detached 14 cells rejoin each long period without changing element identities.
cues.zh: 现在把底部的两段展开，接回第六和第七周期。十八列与三十二列的表包含同一组元素，只是对长周期的安排不同。这里的颜色帮助跟踪各个区，不代表又发现了一批元素。教材要求比较不同形式的设计依据，布局是否清楚呈现关系，比外形是否新奇更重要。
cues.en: The two detached strips now return to periods six and seven. The eighteen-column and thirty-two-column forms contain the same elements, arranged differently. Colour lets you track each region through the change. The textbook asks you to compare the organizing principles of alternative tables: the useful question is which relationships each layout makes easier to see.

cues.title: 一周期怎样闭合
cues.caption: 第三周期依次填入3s、3p，氩完成价层排布。
cues.captionEn: Period three fills 3s and then 3p, ending with argon’s filled valence shell.
cues.zh: 把镜头放到第三周期。钠先占据三s，镁将它填成一对；从铝开始，电子进入三p。三个p轨道先分别占据，再逐一配对，到氩成为三s二、三p六。方框和箭头表示轨道占据与自旋，它们不是电子在空间绕行的轨道线。
cues.en: Focus on period three. Sodium occupies three s, and magnesium completes its pair. Aluminium begins filling three p. The three p orbitals become singly occupied before pairing, reaching three s two, three p six at argon. Boxes and arrows represent orbital occupancy and spin, not paths followed by moving electrons.

cues.title: 排布规则的边界
cues.caption: Cr与Cu的实测基态排布提醒我们：简易填充顺序不是完整计算。
cues.captionEn: Observed Cr and Cu configurations expose limits of the simple filling mnemonic.
cues.zh: 再看铬和铜。铬的基态是三d五、四s一，铜是三d十、四s一，不能把简单的填充口诀机械外推。这些排布是由光谱等证据约束的基态描述。教材把铜、银、金以及锌、镉、汞所在的两列另称ds区，是一种教学分区方式。
cues.en: Now compare chromium and copper. Their ground configurations are three d five, four s one, and three d ten, four s one. A simple filling mnemonic must not override observed ground-state configurations. The textbook separately labels the copper and zinc columns as the d s region; that is the classification used by the colours here.

cues.title: 第三周期的电负性
cues.caption: 教材电负性从Na到Cl增大；Ar的空白不代表零。
cues.captionEn: Textbook electronegativities rise from Na to Cl; Ar’s blank is not zero.
cues.zh: 把第三周期的教材数据画出来。电负性描述成键原子吸引键合电子的相对能力，从钠到氯逐渐增大。这里照录教材的一位小数，因此与你查到的较新数表可能略有差异。氩没有列出数值，图上保留空白，不能把它补成零。
cues.en: Plot the textbook values for period three. Electronegativity describes a bonded atom’s relative attraction for bonding electrons, increasing here from sodium to chlorine. These are the textbook’s rounded values, so another compilation may differ slightly. Argon has no value in this table: missing data must remain missing, not become zero.

cues.title: 沿碱金属族向下
cues.caption: Li到Cs总体减小；教材舍入使K与Rb显示相同值。
cues.captionEn: Values decrease overall from Li to Cs; textbook rounding makes K and Rb equal.
cues.zh: 现在沿锂、钠、钾、铷、铯向下比较。图中的条形总体缩短，但钾和铷都标为零点八。这不是画图错误，而是教材保留一位小数的结果。趋势是一种概括，读取具体数据时仍要保留相等、缺失与例外。
cues.en: Compare lithium, sodium, potassium, rubidium and caesium down the group. The bars become shorter overall, but potassium and rubidium both read zero point eight. That equality comes from textbook rounding. A trend is a summary; the plotted evidence must preserve equal, missing and exceptional values.

cues.title: 遮住碘，先作预测
cues.caption: 先用F、Cl、Br推测I，再揭晓教材值。
cues.captionEn: Use F, Cl and Br to predict I before revealing it.
cues.zh: 先把碘的数值遮住。氟、氯、溴的教材电负性依次降低；它们的价层都以p五结束，但电子所在的能层越来越外。沿着这个方向，你预期碘比溴大，还是小？现在揭晓：二点五，比溴的二点八小。这个比较支持趋势，却不能仅凭电负性就预测所有溶液反应。
cues.en: Hide iodine for a moment. The textbook values fall from fluorine to chlorine to bromine. Each valence configuration ends in p five, but in successively higher shells. Would you expect iodine to be higher or lower than bromine? Reveal the record: two point five, below bromine’s two point eight. This supports the trend; electronegativity alone still cannot predict every solution reaction.

cues.title: 下降的，是哪一个电子？
cues.titleEn: Which electron leaves at each dip?
cues.caption: 追踪被移除的电子，再检验同能量预测。
cues.captionEn: Track the removed electron, then test the same-energy prediction.
cues.zh: 换成第一电离能，曲线出现两个下降。镁移走的是三s电子，铝开始移走能量较高的三p电子，所需能量反而更少。再看磷和硫：磷的三个p轨道各有一个电子，硫多出的电子形成一对；移走这对中的一个，留下三个单占轨道。这是定性解释，具体门槛仍读独立数据。现在给镁和铝同样的六点五电子伏，谁能失去一个电子？铝可以，镁不够。跟踪同一个电子离开后，原子成为正一价离子；电荷总和不变。
cues.en: Switch to first ionization energy: two dips appear. Magnesium loses a three s electron; aluminium loses a higher-energy three p electron and needs less energy. Phosphorus has three singly occupied p orbitals. Sulfur adds a paired electron; removing it leaves three singly occupied orbitals. This explains the pattern qualitatively; the thresholds still come from independent data. Now supply the same six point five electronvolts to magnesium and aluminium. Which can lose an electron? Aluminium can; magnesium cannot. Track that electron as the atom becomes a plus-one ion. Their total charge remains unchanged.

question.zh: 换一种周期表，什么不能变？
question.en: What must survive a new table layout?

lead.zh: 追踪同一个元素，从同列价层结构到长周期的展开。
lead.en: Track the same element through related valence structures and the unfolding long periods.

principle.zh: 布局可以改变，但原子序数、元素身份和周期关系必须保留。
principle.en: The layout may change; atomic number, element identity and periodic relationships must survive.

question.zh: 把f区插回长周期，是否多出28种元素？
question.en: Does reinserting the f block add 28 elements?

explanation.zh: 没有。原有两段各14格被移动，118个元素的身份和顺序保持。
explanation.en: No. Two existing strips of 14 cells move; all 118 identities and their order remain.

question.zh: 周期表怎样保留电子排布的重复？
question.en: How does the table preserve recurring electron structures?

lead.zh: 从同列的ns¹到第三周期的闭合，再让Cr、Cu检验简单填充口诀。
lead.en: Go from recurring ns¹ structures to period-three closure, then test the filling mnemonic against Cr and Cu.

principle.zh: 价层占据解释周期关系，简易规则必须服从光谱约束的基态排布。
principle.en: Valence occupancy explains periodic relationships; simple rules must defer to spectroscopically constrained ground states.

question.zh: 按口诀写出Cu的3d⁹4s²，能直接作为实测基态吗？
question.en: Can the mnemonic prediction 3d⁹4s² be treated as copper’s observed ground state?

explanation.zh: 不能。总电子数正确也不保证分配正确，NIST列出的Cu基态是3d¹⁰4s¹。
explanation.en: No. A correct electron total does not ensure correct occupancy. NIST lists copper’s ground configuration as 3d¹⁰4s¹.

question.zh: 趋势为什么允许相等和下降？
question.en: Why can a trend contain ties and dips?

lead.zh: 先读不被模型改写的教材数据，再追踪电离时离开的电子。
lead.en: Read fixed textbook records first, then track the electron removed during ionization.

principle.zh: 电负性与电离能是不同量；舍入、缺失、轨道和配对必须分别解释。
principle.en: Electronegativity and ionization energy are different quantities. Rounding, missing values, subshells and pairing require distinct explanations.

question.zh: 同给6.5 eV，Mg与Al能否都发生第一电离？
question.en: With the same 6.5 eV, can both Mg and Al undergo first ionization?

explanation.zh: Al约5.986 eV的门槛允许这一通道，Mg约7.646 eV则不够；这是能量条件，不是电离概率。
explanation.en: Al’s threshold is about 5.986 eV, so the channel is allowed; Mg needs about 7.646 eV. This is an energy condition, not an ionization probability.

Occupancy is a qualitative explanation, not a calculation of measured energies. The moving electron is a counting transition, not a spatial path; the selected event neglects recoil and does not calculate absorption probability.

storyboard.evidence: Same selected element retains Z and period while outer ns¹ repeats; H boundary remains visible.
118 persistent cells move continuously; two14-cell strips rejoin existing rows.
3s pair then3p single occupancy/pairing appears on fixed element sequence.
Simple mnemonic and NIST ground-state occupancy shown simultaneously with equal total electron count.
Fixed EN records retain Ar missing; same-period structure shown without computing EN from Z.
Fixed K/Rb tie retained with different ns shell labels; no invented unrounded values.
F/Cl/Br records shown, I value absent through t<17s; then fixed2.5 revealed.
NIST curve first; Mg/Al and P/S selected electron identities next; same6.5eV prediction hidden29–37s; then only Al electron can leave.

scientificBoundaries: Theory/data visualization, not a reaction experiment or a replication of source measurements.
EN follows textbook one-decimal convention; no value for Ar is not zero. EN is not IE or an aqueous electrode potential.
Orbital arrows denote occupancy/spin; the tracked departing electron is a bookkeeping transition, not a spatial trajectory or measured flight time.
Ionization is an energetically allowed selected channel, no cross section or guaranteed absorption; free-electron kinetic energy E−IE neglects recoil.
The 3s/3p and paired-electron arguments are qualitative. No many-electron energy solution or numerical derivation of NIST thresholds is claimed.
The14-cell f insertion is a layout convention, not a decision on group3 membership.
No extrapolation to119 or quantitative eighth-period configuration is claimed.
